spans.s: AT0225 नकुल nakula It is a wild animal, which is included in animate group of poison, i.e. mangoose.
AT0226 नकुलनिर्जिताः nakulanirjitāḥ If the snakes are afflicted by the attacks of mongoose, then the poison of such snakes is mild in nature.
AF1324 नक्षत्र दर्शनं nakṣatra darśanaṁ Sees star like objects
